description: This file defines methods related to writing logs at various levels in the logrus logging library, including creating writers, handling input streams, and finalizing writers.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Represents a logger instance capable of creating writers at different log levels.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a log entry that can write messages at various levels.

methods.name: Writer
methods.description: Returns an io.PipeWriter that writes at INFO level.

methods.name: WriterLevel
methods.description: Returns an io.PipeWriter that writes at the specified log level.

methods.name: writerScanner
methods.description: Scans input from a reader and logs each line using the specified log function.

methods.name: writerFinalizer
methods.description: Closes the writer when it is garbage collected.
